mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psp_event_queue (created_ts, status_id, type_id, reference, original_reference, account_id, account_type_id, psp_account_id, psp_account_type_id, payload) SELECT now(), (SELECT psp_event_status_id FROM psp_event_status WHERE code = 'RECEIVED'), #{eventCodeId}, #{reference}, #{originalReference}, merchant.account_id, merchant.account_type_id, psp.account_id, psp.account_type_id, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb) FROM account merchant CROSS JOIN account psp WHERE merchant.account_id = #{merchantAccountId} AND psp.account_id = #{pspAccountId} ON CONFLICT (psp_account_id, reference, type_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT queue_id, account_id AS merchantAccountId, reference, original_reference, type_id AS eventCodeId, payload::TEXT AS payload FROM psp_event_queue candidate WHERE NOT done AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM psp_event_queue older WHERE older.original_reference = candidate.original_reference AND NOT older.done AND (older.created_ts, older.queue_id) < (candidate.created_ts, candidate.queue_id) ) ORDER BY created_ts, queue_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE psp_event_queue SET status_id = (SELECT psp_event_status_id FROM psp_event_status WHERE code = 'IN_PROGRESS') WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} AND NOT done

UPDATE psp_event_queue SET done = TRUE, done_ts = #{doneTs}, status_id = (SELECT psp_event_status_id FROM psp_event_status WHERE code = 'DONE'), result_id = #{resultId} WHERE queue_id = #{queueId} AND NOT done AND status_id = (SELECT psp_event_status_id FROM psp_event_status WHERE code = 'IN_PROGRESS')
